sources.title: Gemma 4 — Google DeepMind
sources.snippet: Safety Gemma 4 models undergo the same rigorous infrastructure security protocols as our proprietary models. By choosing Gemma 4, enterprises and sovereign organizations gain a trusted, transparent foundation that delivers state-of-the-art capabilities while meeting the highest standards for security and reliability.

sources.title: Gemma 4 E4B — The Daily Driver for Local AI | gemma4.dev
sources.snippet: Models /Gemma 4 E4B Gemma 4 E4B — The Daily Driver for Local AI Gemma 4 E4B is Google's most practical local model: 4.4B parameters, 8GB VRAM minimum, multimodal input, and Thinking Mode — all in a package that runs on any modern consumer GPU.

sources.title: Gemma 4 model card | Google AI for Developers
sources.snippet: Gemma 4 features a context window of up to 256K tokens and maintains multilingual support in over 140 languages. Featuring both Dense and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures, Gemma 4 is well-suited for tasks like text generation, coding, and reasoning. The models are available in five distinct sizes: E2B, E4B, 12B, 26B A4B, and 31B.

sources.title: Gemma 4 — Google DeepMind
sources.snippet: Every Gemma 4 release goes through extensive safety evaluation including red-teaming, bias testing, and responsible AI reviews. We publish detailed model cards for each variant and ship with a built-in responsible use policy.

sources.title: Gemma 4 model overview - Google AI for Developers
sources.snippet: Native System Prompt Support: Gemma 4 introduces built-in support for the system role, enabling more structured and controllable conversations. Multi-Token Prediction: All Gemma 4 models (E2B, E4B, 12B, 31B, and 26B A4B) include a dedicated draft model for speculative decoding, enabling significantly faster inference with no quality loss.
